ITEM 1 | Cubed pale off-white pieces, roughly 1.5-2 cm per side, with light golden-tan edges and slightly irregular cut faces, firm-looking with a matte, lightly moist surface; scattered densely across the upper and middle of the bowl, covering roughly 45% of the bowl's visible area and stacked 2-3 pieces high in places | 150
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets, about 2-3 cm across, with dark green tops and some slightly yellowed stems, firm and matte, scattered around the rim and between cubes, covering roughly 10% of the bowl | 40
ITEM 3 | Dark green leafy greens (mixed lettuce leaves), some flat and glossy, some ruffled and frilly, lying in a thin layer under and around the other items, covering roughly 35% of the bowl's visible area with pale green midribs | 60
ITEM 4 | Reddish-brown, slightly glossy pieces with a soft, moist, layered look, partly hidden under the greens on the right side, covering roughly 8% of the bowl area, about 0.5 cm thick | 25
